notes.title: New challenge achievements
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29162925/cca9a3452f67a568a7bdaf601fc7f8087cc41ace.png[/img]

We've been working hard to make Just In Time Incorporated available on every VR headset, but we wanted to sneak in some new fun stuff too. So in that vein we've added 17 new challenge achievements. Some encourage finding new ways to solve levels, while others will challenge your reflexes through the crucible of glorious combat.

notes.title: Small patch with fix for Oculus object jitter
notes.notes: This patch addresses the Oculus Rift issue where objects being held would jitter significantly. If you encounter any other issues please contact help@secondwindinteractive.com, we want your experience to be perfect!

notes.title: Performance enhancements
notes.notes: We've just pushed a small update to enhance performance of the game. On our min-spec GPUs (970 GTX and R9 290) you will see up to 50% gain in FPS under certain circumstances. If you have a beefier GPU this patch should also help if you want to bump up the super sampling in the SteamVR settings.

notes.title: Oculus Rift now fully supported!
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that we finally have full support for the Oculus Rift! Do you have two sensors? Three? It doesn't matter! We put a ton of time into making sure the game is fun as a seated experience all the way up to a full room-scale setup. 

All VR systems will have access to the following new quality of life improvements:
[list]
[*]Directional teleport (on by default for Rift)
[*]Force pull (on by default for Rift and standing room only Vive)
[*]D-pad/Touchpad turning with 90 or 180 degree settings (off by default)
[/list]

Existing players will notice that they now have their own private office at headquarters. Here you can see all of the clients you have saved, your promotion trophies, your current stats, as well as being able to change any of the options we have added. From within a level you can also access your office by clicking the gear icon on the top left of your clipboard.

notes.title: Patch v1.2.0 - Music!! (and misc. improvements)
notes.notes:
We've been given a lot of feedback that the game desperately needed music. We... listened (ha ha, ugh) and have updated the game with a ton of new tracks themed for the various different types of levels. 

Have you wanted to feel like you are in an 80's corporate training video? Try the tutorial again! Do you want to feel a sense of adventure also reminiscent of an 80's action adventure? Get to the choppa ASAP!. How about the juxtaposition of a whimsical tune and people exploding into small pieces? Better start body searching again.

[h1]Misc. Fixes and Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Buttons can now be clicked just by pushing your finger into them. In hindsight we probably should have had it this way from the start.
[*] Visual character damage. Now when you commit acts of violence against people you will see them become bruised and bloodied from your morally questionable actions.
[*] Melee combat is more satisfying as characters are no longer one hit knock-outs with small and medium sized objects. Combined with the visual damage system, it's a whole new experience!
[*] Added toggle switches in the headquarters for disabling music and gore.
[*] Bunch of small bug fixes under the hood.
[/list]

[h1]Future Plans[/h1]

We are preparing a huge 2.0 update that we will announce more details about in the coming weeks. All we can say now is that a new and ominous competitor has begun interfering with your employer and you will need to deal with it.

notes.title: Patch v1.1.0 - More levels!
notes.notes:
We've released the first batch of new levels that skew more towards the harder end of the spectrum. Here's a little teaser:
[list]
[*]Not the One - Mr. Sanderson is in need of a little help...
[*]The Crows - Dr. Peta is at it again...
[*]Lost in the Woods - Billy Bob isn't quite the hunter he thought he was...
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a freeze that could happen during a load screen if the system menu button were pressed at a certain time.
[*]Bullets no longer insta-kill an enemy when held and rubbed against them.
[*]Bullets hitting a dead body weren't making any sounds, how boring!
[/list]

If you encounter any issues with the game, please contact us and follow [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/592030/discussions/0/1471966894870864315/]these steps[/url].

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Just In Time Incorporated, 10% off!
notes.notes:
Just In Time Incorporated is Now Available on Steam for HTC Vive and is 10% off!*

As a "Death Prevention Insurance agent, your job is saving clients from certain death as disasters play out in slow-motion. Your Hyper-Gloves allow you to move super-fast, teleport, and even catch bullets. It's a good thing too, because death lurks in every corner in this virtual reality action/comedy.

*Offer ends August 3 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: Content Update Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hi all, we want to be as transparent as possible about what we are up to and how we will support the game moving forward. Right now we are hard at work on getting the first content update prepared. We don't have a set date yet, but it'll be measured in weeks not months.

Our main priority will be fleshing out more of the end-game content. That means harder missions. Expect many more near-death experiences and loss of client life. You have been warned.

As soon as we can finalize a date we'll post another announcement. We will also be active on our [url=steamcommunity.com/app/592030/discussions]Community Hub[/url] if you have any questions or feedback you'd like to add.

Thanks!
